policy: One shared title and one shared type-line fit. Font/size/offsets selected only on 23 calibration printings, then checked on 57 reserved printings with frozen scan-only poses. The actual painter is measured with independent grayscale edge distance and Census; source-assisted artwork lies outside these regions. All pixels outside the two header regions are unchanged across all 81 cards.
metric: Expected-ink-polarity dark edge F1 and Census: higher is better; symmetric mean edge distance: lower is better. These are component measurements, not whole-card accuracy.
fontFinding: Both Conjurer matrix.ttf and matrix-b.ttf identify as Matrix Bold and produce identical captured header glyphs. MSE ModMatrix matches the existing glyphs; genuine MSE Matrix Medium scores lower on calibration printings. Retain the existing loaded Matrix Bold; no font dependency was added.
